subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Groups common words into sound families

show.line: Let's show what we know! Sort the words into families. ot, en, ug. Ready?

rounds.prompt: Listen. r, u, g. What word is it?
Which family? ot, en or ug? Sort the words.
Leg. Change l to p. What word do you make?
Which word does not belong in the ug family?
rounds.praise: Bus ends with s, not g.

rounds.text: The bug is in the mug.
accept: the bug is in the mug
the bug is in the mug.

hints: Listen to the end of the word. That is the family.
Sound it out. First sound, then the rest.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will sort bus.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Bus goes in the ug family!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bus ends in us, not ug.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen to the end. Bus. Us, not ug!

parent_line: Can sort words into sound families and read them.
